sources.quote: NVIDIA investigating Gentlemen ransomware breach claims
Nvidia adds possible hack to list of very bad things under investigation

claims.statement: Nvidia is investigating claims of a security breach after being listed by the Gentlemen ransomware group.

sources.quote: the Gentlemen ransomware group has added the company to its dark web data leak site

claims.statement: The Gentlemen ransomware group added Nvidia to its dark-web data-leak site.

sources.quote: Ransomware group sets a deadline for the chipmaker to pay up - or see its data leaked

claims.statement: The ransomware group set a deadline for Nvidia to pay up or have its data leaked.

headline: Nvidia investigates ransomware group's breach claims
summary: Nvidia is investigating claims of a security breach after the Gentlemen ransomware group added the company to its dark-web data-leak site. The group has set a deadline for Nvidia to pay up or see its data leaked.
